title: About Us
text:
About Us DISCOVER DARGLOBAL LIVE ALL IN DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging - value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward. Learn More ZIAD EL CHAAR Founder & Chief Executive Officer The end result that we want to deliver to you is simple: happiness. Global presence Global offices Salses Offices City project Our project PROUDLY LISTED ON THE LONDON STOCK EXCHANGE WHERE AMBITION LIVES. Our premium properties are strategically located in established and emerging markets. Creating opportunities to expand your world. While growing your wealth. Our international portfolio spans exquisite residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with iconic luxury brands, including Aston Martin, and Lamborghini. Design. Lifestyle. Investment value. Every DarGlobal property seeks to enrich all three. YOUR WORLD. YOUR WAY. True global citizens want to live without borders. Or compromises. We offer thoughtfully designed homes in desirable settings that cater to your international way of life. Freedom and flexibility. Comfort and culture. Security and service. Wherever you go, find the fundamentals here. BUILT ON TRUST. We draw on over 31 years of luxury development experience to move with agility. Adapting to stay ahead of the market. Anticipating investors’ needs. Leveraging exceptional talent and partnerships. Always guided by purpose. Our commitment to quality and people-first thinking sets us apart. We don’t just build differently. We’re built different. INVESTOR RELATIONS Learn More find your next investment find your next investment BOOK NOW get in touch title: Privacy Policy title: Introduction content:

DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.

This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.

This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.

title: Acceptance content:

By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.

title: Information content:

You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:

EMAIL REGISTRATION
Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.

CONTACT US
The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.

RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM
The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.

CREDIT INFORMATION
Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

title: Cookies content:

We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.

title: Information Safety​ content:

The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.

title: Information Usage content:

The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

title: AIDA 360°
text:
AIDA 360°
AIDA 360°
Muscat
Oman
Welcome to AIDA 360° - your dedicated DarGlobal concierge for everything that makes owning at AIDA effortless. From residency permits and fast-track banking to holiday-let management, remote handovers, and fee-free resale, every service you might need sits one click away.
JOIN OUR TELEGRAM CHANNEL & STAY UPDATED
tailored services
Residency Permit Facilitation
Enjoy a seamless process in securing an Omani residency permit through property ownership, with guidance on documentation and eligibility criteria.
learn more
Client-to-Client Referral Program
Introduce friends or family to the AIDA lifestyle and receive exclusive rewards when your referrals become homeowners.
learn more
Omani Bank Account Facilities
Open a local bank account with the support of our team, ensuring access to financial services in Oman for property-related transactions.
learn more
Short-Term Rental Facilitators
All AIDA properties are pre-approved for Airbnb and UnderTheDoormat. We connect you with trusted short-term rental agencies to handle the rest.
learn more
AIDA Credit Card
Apply for an exclusive AIDA-branded credit card offering lifestyle rewards, discounts within AIDA, and benefits for property-related expenses.
learn more
Insignia Program
DarGlobal covers the card’s annual fee, unlocking 24/7 personal-concierge and shopping services, bespoke travel planning, and invitations to exclusive events and partner privileges worldwide.
learn more
Owner Perks
Gain access to exclusive discounts, partner offers, and premium services across AIDA and selected DarGlobal properties.
learn more
Remote Handover & Key Release
Can’t be in Oman for handover? No problem. DarGlobal offers secure remote handover services and digital documentation to ensure a smooth key collection process, wherever you are.
learn more
Free Assignment Service
Benefit from a complimentary assignment service for ownership transfer prior to handover, subject to terms and conditions.
learn more
Owner-Association Representation
Stay informed and involved through DarGlobal’s support in establishing and participating in the AIDA Owners’ Association, ensuring your voice is heard.
learn more
Mortgage Program for Foreign Owners
Exclusive mortgage program in Oman for resident
and non-resident buyers, designed to enhance
real estate returns.
learn more

title: DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments
text:
DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments Blogs Nov 13, 2026 Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements. Nov 06, 2026 Future of Branded Residences The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living. Oct 30, 2026 How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage. Oct 16, 2026 Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property. Oct 09, 2026 Luxury Waterfront Properties: What Makes Them So Valuable? Few asset classes hold the prestige, financial resilience, and emotional appeal of a waterfront luxury property. Whether situated along iconic coastlines, serene lakeshores, or private island enclaves, prime waterfront real estate consistently commands the highest valuations in global real estate. Oct 05, 2026 The Complete Guide to Investing in Dubai Off-Plan Properties Investing in real estate has consistently proven to be a cornerstone of global wealth creation, and few markets capture the imagination of international investors quite like Dubai. Sep 25, 2026 What Makes a Luxury Real Estate Developer Worth Investing With? Investing in prime property requires evaluating the entity building the asset just as rigorously as the geographic location itself. In the upper echelons of residential real estate, a developer’s execution capability, strategic vision, and brand equity directly influence total returns. Sep 18, 2026 How Luxury Real Estate Supports Global Mobility and Residency For high-net-worth individuals, physical property is no longer merely a domestic store of wealth or a passive asset class. In an increasingly interconnected economic landscape, prime residential real estate serves as an anchor for international freedom, sovereign risk management, and borderless lifestyle planning. Sep 11, 2026 Why Luxury Real Estate Should Be Part of Every Investment Portfolio High-net-worth investors and family offices constantly refine their capital allocation strategies to protect wealth while driving sustainable growth. While equities, fixed income, and venture capital remain traditional staples, adding physical prime property introduces unique structural stability. Sep 04, 2026 How Luxury Real Estate Creates Long-Term Wealth High-net-worth individuals consistently turn to prime property as a cornerstone for portfolio expansion and legacy preservation. Unlike standard housing, prime residential real estate operates under distinct financial mechanics. Examining the foundational drivers of luxury property ROI demonstrates how strategic acquisitions secure lasting wealth across market cycles. Aug 31, 2026 Luxury Real Estate Trends That Will Shape 2026 The high-end residential housing market is entering an era defined by intentionality, technological discretion, and health-focused architecture. Modern high-net-worth buyers are re-evaluating what true luxury means, shifting away from ostentatious displays of size toward functional elegance, sustainability, and personal well-being. Understanding the dominant luxury real estate trends is essential for investors, developers, and homeowners looking to build long-term value in a dynamic market. Aug 21, 2026 Is Buying a Second Home Still a Smart Investment? The real estate landscape has evolved rapidly over the past few years. Driven by shifting workplace norms, evolving interest rate environments, and changing lifestyle priorities, buyers are looking at real estate with a fresh perspective. One central question consistently emerges for high-net-worth individuals and capital allocators: Is buying a second home still a smart investment? Aug 14, 2026 Best Countries for Luxury Real Estate Investment in 2026 The global prime property market is undergoing a structural transformation. Driven by evolving financial policies, strategic wealth preservation initiatives, and dynamic economic shifts, high-net-worth individuals are continually evaluating where to allocate long-term capital. Identifying the best countries to invest in real estate requires a balanced framework that goes far beyond aesthetic appeal. Smart cross-border investors prioritize high capital appreciation potential, robust rental yields, direct tax optimization, structural liquidity, and long-term residency advantages. Aug 10, 2026 How International Investors Buy Luxury Property with Confidence The global distribution of private capital has changed the way premium real estate is acquired. Today, high-net-worth individuals do not limit their portfolios to their home countries. Instead, they actively seek institutional stability, lifestyle flexibility, and high capital growth across multiple borders. text:
Development Management
DEVELOPMENT
MANAGEMENT
Maximizing potential and long-term value for every project
We take a strategic approach to third-party developments, ensuring adherence to timelines, cost considerations, and quality standards.
By collaborating with administrators, financial and legal advisors, designers,
and contractors, we handle all aspects, relieving the client of any stress.
our services
We follow a strategic approach to development management, by overseeing the entire
journey from initial concept to final handover, to ensure maximize returns on investment.
Project Planning
Our comprehensive project planning is tailored to meet business objectives within agreed timelines, scope, and quality specifications.
Acquiring Approvals
We work to minimise delays, ensuring project continuity and reducing operational risks.
Feasibility Analysis
Our predictive analysis considers market, financial, and economic feasibility to identify and address potential challenges early.
Project Monitoring & Reporting
By providing a macro overview as well as detailed reports, we empower you to make informed decisions and proactively manage risks.
Sales & Marketing
Each project receives bespoke pre- and post-sale support from our capable team to ensure that projected targets are achieved.

Global Real Estate Developments & Luxury Properties
At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.
discover more
Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.
discover more
Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.
discover more
asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.
EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES
Tokenization
Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access
We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.
Real Estate Tokenization
This Is What It Means to Live All In
Collaborations
Discover unique luxury properties through our exclusive collaborations.
About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.
WHY INVEST WITH DARGLOBAL

title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
text:
FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
Frequently Asked Questions
DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.
Why invest with DarGlobal?
DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.
Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.
What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
ROI (Return on Investment)
: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.
ROE (Return on Ego)
: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.
ROL (Return on Legacy)
: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.
We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.
Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.
With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.
What makes DarGlobal different?
We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.
Where does DarGlobal operate?
Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
What types of properties do you offer?
We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.
Why partner with global brands?
They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status.
Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.
Can international buyers invest?
Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.
How does the buying process work?
Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.
Investing with DarGlobal
Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.
How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?
Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.
What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?
Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.
Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?
Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.
What kind of returns can I expect?
Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.
Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?
Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.
Our Luxury Properties & Projects
Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.
What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?
From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.
Where are DarGlobal properties located?
Across the world’s most desirable destinations:
Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,
and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.
What are co-branded residences?
These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.
Which upcoming projects are open for investment?
Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.
Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable?
Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.
Collaborations & Brand Partnerships
Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.
Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with?
DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.
What makes co-branded residences unique?
They offer something few can own:
ROE — Return on Ego.
Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.
How do partnerships enhance property value?
Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.
Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon?
DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.
How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence?
Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.
Buying Process & Ownership
Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors.
What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property?
1. Choose your property
2. Review the investment plan with our advisors
3. Reserve your unit securely
4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide
5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team
Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties?
Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable.
What payment plans are available?
Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency.
How does property registration work?
Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.
What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase?
Typically:
1. Passport copy
2. Contact information
3. Reservation form
4. Payment details
Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step.
About DarGlobal
Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment.
Who is DarGlobal?
DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging.
How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate?
DarGlobal is backed by over
three decades of development experience
, delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust.
What makes DarGlobal different?
We deliver more than properties — we deliver results:
1. Wealth protected across cycles
2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship
3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development.
Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in?
DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across
14 cities in 9 countries
, including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives.
Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded?
Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance.

THE INTERNSHIP
PROGRAM
The DarGlobal Internship Program is designed to provide students and recent graduates with a unique, hands-on opportunity
to gain invaluable experience in the dynamic world of real estate development. Interns will work alongside industry professionals,
contribute to exciting live projects, and acquire practical skills that will set them up for long-term career success. This program offers
not just exposure to day-to-day operations but deep insight into the strategic aspects of real estate development.
What We Look For
Strong problem-solving abilities
Effective communication skills
A collaborative mindset
Enthusiasm for learning
Explore open internship roles
Marketing Intern
dubai, united arab emirates
Marketing
We’re looking for a creative and driven Marketing Intern to support our marketing team in executing campaigns, managing content, and analyzing performance. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand development, digital marketing, and communications across various platforms.

title: Investor | Luxury Second Homes by DarGlobal
text:
Investor | Luxury Second Homes by DarGlobal Investor Relations ABOUT INVESTORS CORPORATE GOVERNANCE DarGlobal Today DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities. Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters. DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. FACTSHEET LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few. A GLOBAL PRESENCE From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha. leadership As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK. Ziad el chaar Founder & chief executive officer DarGlobal at a Glance Total GDV USD Presence in Cities Presence in Countries Global Sales Offices title: Privacy Policy title: Introduction content:

DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.

This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.

This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.

title: Acceptance content:

By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.

title: Information content:

You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:

EMAIL REGISTRATION
Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.

CONTACT US
The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.

RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM
The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.

CREDIT INFORMATION
Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

title: Cookies content:

We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.

title: Information Safety​ content:

The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.

title: Information Usage content:

The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

We own, invest, develop, and operate high-end real estate that delivers long-term value, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals, and disciplined execution across target international property markets.

Global Real Estate Developments & Luxury Properties
At the core of DarGlobal is a disciplined development model focused on delivering architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in high-growth global locations. From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

Building Luxury Communities
We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.
From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

HOSPITALITY & LEISURE
We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.
Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

Private membership
Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.
From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

GOLF
Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.
These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.
discover more
Commercial
We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.
Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

asseT MANAGEMENT
REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.
EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES
Tokenization
Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access
We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.
Real Estate Tokenization
This Is What It Means to Live All In
Collaborations
Discover unique luxury properties through our exclusive collaborations.
About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

Access Interest Lounge
A WORLD OF ONE’S OWN
For those who live and invest inimitably. Who understands that rarity is its own reward. Who have everything and settle for nothing. This is the Premiere Edition Collection. A curated selection of ultra-rare residences, crafted for true connoisseurs, and located in the world’s most extraordinary settings. No copies. No compromises. Singularly yours.
AVAILABLE ON REQUEST
AIDA | Oman
Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa
Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community.
Interiors by FENDI Casa.
Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you.
Only the horizon.

The Trump Penthouse
Inspired by the exclusive 5th Avenue penthouse in New York, we are introducing the Only two penthouses that’ll exist in the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai. Both are duplexes. Both have private pools facing the Burj Khalifa. Each spans two levels with 180° views—from Downtown to the sea. There won’t be a third. This is it.

Al Marjan Island, RAK, UAE
Top Of the Astera
Introducing the Top of the Astera – the world’s first villa in the sky with interiors by Aston Martin. Rising above Al Marjan Island, this masterpiece redefines luxury, offering breathtaking views and unparalleled elegance. Experience the prestige of living above the clouds and beyond the ordinary.

Unlisted With Interiors By Pagani

7&8 Albert Hall Mansions

From landmark towers featuring premium luxury apartments in Dubai and Qatar to bespoke, ultra-luxury villas in Spain and the GCC, every project is meticulously designed to balance elite desirability, structural efficiency, and long-term capital appreciation.

We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.

REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH
| PARTNERSHIP FIRST
Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.
EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES

Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access
We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

About DarGlobal
Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment
DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.
Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.
With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

Terms & Conditions
Before proceeding with the payment online, the customer must read, understand, and accept the following terms and conditions for the payment facility online.
User's Declaration
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).
Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation.
I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit.
I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.
I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.
I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
Acknowledgements
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).
If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).
The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

title: Privacy Policy | DarGlobal
text:
Privacy Policy | DarGlobal title: Privacy Policy title: Introduction content:

DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.

This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.

This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.

title: Acceptance content:

By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.

title: Information content:

You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:

EMAIL REGISTRATION
Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.

CONTACT US
The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.

RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM
The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.

CREDIT INFORMATION
Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.

title: Cookies content:

We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.

title: Information Safety​ content:

The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.

title: Information Usage content:

The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

title: DarGlobal | Tokenization
text:
DarGlobal | Tokenization
Tokenization: Investing in the Future, Today
DarGlobal is evolving how the world invests in luxury real estate. Through blockchain-powered tokenization, we’re making access to high-value properties smarter, more flexible, and globally connected.
What Does This Mean for You?
We’re turning physical assets into digital tokens - fractional shares of our premium properties that investors can buy, sell, or hold. This opens the door to new opportunities:
Simplified Access
Invest in DarGlobal’s most exclusive projects from anywhere in the world.
Liquidity with Confidence
Trade your tokens through regulated platforms while knowing you’re backed by real-world assets.
Security & Transparency
Every transaction is recorded on a secure blockchain, ensuring full visibility and trust.
Fractional Ownership
Own a share of luxury residences without the complexity of traditional real estate deals.
Why Tokenization with DarGlobal?
We deliver real investments with real returns. Tokenization is a new key unlocking smarter, more agile ownership models:
It’s not about trends, it’s about expanding your portfolio.
It’s not about crypto hype, it’s about enhancing liquidity.
It’s not about making noise, it’s about giving global citizens more control.
With tokenization, DarGlobal is future-proofing real estate investment for discerning investors. This is how you invest differently.

SECURE YOUR FUTURE
Investing in real estate unlocks more than a home. Discover the freedom to live anywhere. Tax benefits. Long-term stability. Strategic investment opens doors to new possibilities.
Read More
Saudi Arabia: Residency Through Investment
Saudi Arabia: Residency Through Investment
Invest 4M SAR (Approx 1.07M USD) to secure Saudi residency and its exclusive benefits.
Enjoy a 30-year corporate tax exemption, ensuring long-term financial advantages.
The Saudi Riyal (SAR) is pegged to USD, offering currency stability for investors.
Investors can now open a bank account in Saudi Arabia while on a visit visa.
Oman: Lifetime Residency for Investors
Oman: Lifetime Residency for Investors
Invest in real estate and obtain lifetime residency.
Hassle-free bank account setup for investors.
0% Personal income tax ensures greater financial gains.
0% Import or export duties, making business operations seamless.
Qatar: A Gateway to Prosperity
Qatar: A Gateway to Prosperity
Tax Benefits
No personal income tax and no property tax, maximizing returns.
Competitive corporate tax rates make Qatar an attractive business hub.
Permanent Residency
Obtain permanent residency by investing
3,650,000 QAR (1 million USD), providing
long-term residency and access to
Qatar’s benefits.
Investor Visa Program
Offers residency to investors who purchase real estate in Qatar with a minimum investment of 728,000 QAR (200,000 USD). Upon confirmation of payment, the Ministry of Justice issues a Sanad Mabdayi, a temporary title deed recognizing ownership. This enables investors to apply for residency even before project completion, under the new government-approved framework.
United Arab Emirates (UAE): 10-Year Golden Visa
United Arab Emirates (UAE): 10-Year Golden Visa
Invest 2 million AED (Approx 545,000 USD)
in real estate, now including off-plan properties, to obtain a 10-year Golden Visa.
0% Income Tax
ensures maximum earnings.
0% Property Tax
making real estate investment even
more lucrative.
Take the first step towards a secure and prosperous future.
Invest wisely and unlock the benefits of residency in these thriving economies.

JOIN THE RAFFLE - WIN A TRIP TO DUBAI
By participating in this campaign, brokers agree to the following Terms & Conditions:
1. Eligibility
Only registered brokers with DarGlobal are eligible to participate.
All participants must hold a valid passport with at least 6 months’ validity from DDMMYYYY.
Visa Application will be handled by the applicants themselves and DAR GLOBAL is not responsible nor can help for providing visa approvals to the UAE. In the incident that applicants are not able to have their visas approved, the prize will be forfeited without compensation or substitution.
2. How to Enter
Eligible brokers will automatically be entered into the raffle upon completing the registration
Each registered broker is entitled to single entry
3. Period
This Raffle commences on the DD MM YYYY at (timing) and will end on DD MM YYYY at (timing)
4. Reward
Winner will win a trip for two (2) to the Dubai for a total of X nights
The trip will include First Class or Business Class flights (depending on availability), including hotel, full board and many surprises curated by DarGlobal.
The reward is non-transferable, non-exchangeable, and has no cash value.
5. Announcement & Trip Details
The winner will be selected randomly from all eligible brokers.
Winner will be contacted directly by DDMMYYYY, with trip details shared thereafter.
If the winner cannot be reached within X days, DarGlobal reserves the right to select another eligible broker.
The trip is tentatively scheduled for Q3 or Q4 2025 (exact dates to be confirmed).
6. Disqualification
DarGlobal reserves the right to disqualify any broker found to have provided false or misleading information or engaged in fraudulent activity.
7. General
DarGlobal reserves the right to amend these Terms & Conditions or cancel the campaign at any time without prior notice.
Participation constitutes acceptance of these Terms & Conditions.

KEY FEATURES
The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai brings together three iconic worlds in one address: a five-star hotel, a members-only club, and private residences, each with its own state-of-the-art amenities.
Trump International Hotel & Tower
A five-star luxury hotel, joining the legacy of Trump organization most
iconic hotels.
Featuring fine dining, world-class entertainment, and true luxury at every
turn.
The Trump, Members-Only Club
The Trump Members-Only Club brings together wellness, business, and the
timeless atmosphere of a classic private club. Access is limited to members
only through an annual fee, with residents receiving priority access.
The Trump Residences
Featuring 1, 2, & 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses, the residences dominate the skyline — with every unit offering a view.
Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the highest outdoor pool in the world.
AMENITIES OF THE TRUMP RESIDENCES
The following amenities are reserved exclusively for residents. Residents can also apply for membership to the Trump Members-Only Club to access its iconic spaces and experience the full lifestyle.
Rooftop infinity pool, the highest in the world
State of the art gym
Owners lounge
Kids play area
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump Tower Jeddah?
Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. It offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses with direct Red Sea views, alongside the Trump Private Club for residents and members.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The tower offers one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments as well as three- and four-bedroom penthouses, ranging from 70 to 365 sqm. All units are positioned on the Jeddah Corniche and face the Red Sea.
When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?
Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download.
Where exactly is Trump Tower Jeddah located?
The tower sits on the Jeddah Corniche along Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastline. It offers easy access to the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit, and the King Fahd Fountain, placing residents at the intersection of coastal living and the city's key landmarks.
Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization?
No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property.
What is the Trump Private Club at Trump Tower Jeddah?
The Trump Private Club is a resident-focused facility within the tower offering fine dining, a cigar lounge, meeting rooms, a gym, a yoga zone, swimming pool pool, kids pool, jacuzzi, and 24/7 concierge services.
What amenities does Trump Tower Jeddah offer?
Amenities include the Trump Private Club, 24/7 concierge, fine dining, and cigar lounge, meeting rooms, gym, yoga zone, pool, kids' pool, jacuzzi, and uninterrupted Red Sea views from one of the tallest towers in Jeddah Corniche.
Why invest in Jeddah real estate under Saudi Vision 2030?
Saudi Arabia offers 0% income tax and capital gains tax, a 30-year corporate tax exemption, and premium Saudi residency eligibility for investments of 4 million SAR or more. The SAR is pegged to the US dollar, and Saudi Arabia hosts Expo 2030 and the 2034 FIFA World Cup.
What makes Trump Tower Jeddah's location on the Corniche valuable?
The Jeddah Corniche is the city's most sought-after coastal address. The tower's seafront position, proximity to the marina and F1 circuit, and its Standing as one of the tallest buildings on the strip place it at the centre of Jeddah's long-term urban and tourism growth corridor.
How do I register interest or buy a unit at Trump Tower Jeddah?
Buyers can register interest, book a unit, explore available units via the online residence navigator, or download the brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current pricing and payment plan terms on request.

title: Residency Permit Facilitation
text:
Residency Permit Facilitation Residency Permit Facilitation Secure Your Permanent Residency Live, work, and invest in Oman—seamlessly. Owning at AIDA is your gateway to long-term life in Oman. This service turns a stack of government paperwork into one clear, concierge-managed process—from your first multi-entry visa to the day your permanent residency card is issued. Why Apply Immediate multi-entry visa while your villa is under construction Full permanent residency the day you take hand-over Dedicated visa concierge to handle every government touch-point Unlock Exclusive Residency Foreign nationals can obtain a residency visa by investing in real estate within Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC) in Oman. GOLDEN VISA PROGRAM Residency Before Handover: Owner can apply to 1 Year renewable residency post unit purchase and execution of the SPA- NOC and multi entry Visa will be provided by DarGlobal. Personal presence in Oman Police is required. After Handover: 2, 5 & 10 year residency can be issued depending on investment amount and after issuance of the title deed. All the above types of residencies are renewable(subject to maintaining the investment) and can be extended to the first-degree family members. and subject to security clearance. Multi entry Visa Multi Entry Visa: During the construction period, A multiple-entry visa for the investor and his immediate family members can be issued post-unit purchase and execution of the SPA ( validity is 1 year and can be renewed) Checklist A. Multi entry Visa - Required Documents Valid Passport Passport size photo Attested Marriage certificate & Birth certificate (if applies for direct family members application) B. Residency - Required Documents Passport copy (valid 6 + months) Recent passport-size photo Oman police clearance Attested Marriage certificate & Birth certificate (if applies for direct family members application) How It Works Upload Documents ► Easily submit your paperwork through our secure portal. Concierge Review (1 Business Day) ► Our team reviews and files your MoI visa application promptly. Multi Entry Visa Initiated ► Upon SPA execution, we automatically begin your multi entry visa application. title: Banking Facilities (Omani Bank Account)
text:
Banking Facilities (Omani Bank Account)
Banking Facilities (Omani Bank Account)
Open Your Omani Bank Account—Fast
Foreign clients often find Omani bank onboarding slow. We’ve pre-negotiated
fast-track channels so you can open multi-currency accounts without setting
foot in a branch.
Checklist
A. Required Documents – Individual Applicant
Copy of passport and resident card
Proof of address
Bank statements for the last 6 months
B-Required Documents – Corporate Applicant
Company documents (CR, MEM)
Copies of passports and resident cards for both shareholders
Proof of address for the company and the owners
Residential utility bills for the company and the owners
Company tax certificate
Bank statements for the last 6 months (company account and owners’ personal accounts from existing bank relationships)
Lease agreement for Sohar Free Zone
How It Works
Upload Documents ► Submit your documents securely to begin the process.
2-Business Day Pre-Screen ►
Our team reviews your file and connects you with a partner bank.
Account Opening ►
The bank will send an email confirmation with bank account details.
Important:
Final approval at bank’s discretion. T&Cs apply.

AIDA Credit Card
A Card That Mirrors Your Investment
Turn your investment into immediate lifestyle benefits. The AIDA Credit Card mirrors your instalment payments, giving you spending power as you invest. Use it to furnish your home, travel the world, and unlock exclusive rewards—every instalment brings you more.
Checklist
Passport copy
Proof of payment schedule
How It Works
Upload Documents ► Submit your documents securely to initiate the card issuance process.
14-Business Day Issuance ► Your AIDA Credit Card is processed and approved within three business days.
Card Delivered by Courier ► Receive your physical card at your doorstep—ready to use upon arrival.
Spend Instantly ► Start using your card immediately. Your spending limit grows with each instalment you make.
Important:
Annual fee applies; credit limit tied to cleared payments. Bank KYC required. T&Cs apply.

title: Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For
text:
Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements. To appeal to modern affluent buyers, developers and sellers must look beyond cosmetic grandeur. The most sought-after luxury home features combine privacy, architectural purpose, advanced technology, and curated lifestyle amenities. 1. Advanced Privacy and Discreet Security Systems For ultra-affluent buyers, personal privacy and security are non-negotiable foundations. Modern security infrastructure extends far beyond standard alarm systems or perimeter fencing: Biometric and AI Access Control: Facial recognition, keyless entry systems, and automated license plate readers ensure seamless yet tightly monitored access. Dedicated Security Suites: On-site guard quarters, subterranean safe rooms, and independent power microgrids offer continuous protection during emergencies. Acoustic and Architectural Shielding: Strategic landscaping, deep setbacks, and soundproof glazing safeguard residential privacy from public sightlines and urban noise. 2. Integrated Health and Longevity Amenities Wellness has shifted from an occasional indulgence to a daily lifestyle priority. The contemporary HNWI buyer expects sanctuary-grade health facilities built directly into their home: Medical-Grade Environmental Controls: Advanced indoor air purification, oxygen-enriched sleeping quarters, and multi-stage water filtration systems maintain optimal indoor health standards. Recovery and Spa Suites: Dedicated wellness wings featuring cryotherapy chambers, infrared saunas, cold plunge pools, and red-light therapy rooms cater to physical recovery and performance. Biophilic Architectural Design: Indoor gardens, natural light optimization, and living walls help reduce stress and enhance psychological well-being. 3. Experiential Entertaining and Collection Showcases Luxury homes are designed to serve as backdrop spaces for social entertaining and private collections. Rather than standard reception rooms, affluent buyers look for specialized lifestyle environments: Sommelier-Grade Wine Vaults: Temperature- and humidity-controlled cellars equipped with digital inventory tracking systems showcase rare vintages. Automotive Galleries: Climate-controlled, showroom-style garages equipped with vehicle lifts allow collectors to display classic and exotic cars as functional art. Culinary Prep Kitchens: Dual-kitchen layouts pair a polished open-concept main kitchen with a secondary heavy-prep scullery, allowing professional catering teams to operate out of sight during events. 4. Resort-Style Outdoor Living Spaces Extending primary living zones into the outdoors expands usable square footage and creates a vacation-like atmosphere at home. Popular outdoor luxury home features include: Infinity Edge Pools and Cabanas: Temperature-controlled swimming pools equipped with underwater sound systems, private cabanas, and integrated spa features. Outdoor Culinary Stations: Fully equipped outdoor kitchens featuring built-in wood-fired pizza ovens, professional rotisseries, and climate-controlled bar areas. Secluded Leisure Grounds: Private putting greens, pickleball courts, and fire lounges offer year-round outdoor recreation options. 5. Intuitive Smart Home Infrastructure Technology should simplify daily life without feeling overly complex. Today's buyers prefer invisible, intuitive automation systems over complicated user interfaces: Unified Home Automation: Centralized platforms manage climate, motorized shades, architectural lighting scenes, and audio-visual setups across the entire estate. Sustainable Energy Storage: Solar energy roofing integrated with battery storage arrays and geothermal heating ensures energy self-sufficiency and operational efficiency. Dedicated Remote Workspaces: Soundproof executive suites equipped with commercial-grade telecommunications infrastructure support global business management from home. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1. What is the single most important feature for an HNWI buyer when evaluating a property? Uncompromising privacy and location. While amenities can be added or updated, an estate's physical location, micro-climate, sightline protections, and neighborhood security cannot be replicated. 2. How are wellness features changing the design of luxury properties? Wellness amenities have evolved from standard home gyms to fully integrated spa and recovery suites. Buyers now look for medical-grade air and water filtration, circadian lighting systems, cold plunges, and dedicated recovery spaces. 3. Do sustainable and green features appeal to high-net-worth buyers? Yes. Sustainable luxury features such as solar generation, battery storage, smart glass windows, and geothermal systems offer energy independence, lower environmental impact, and long-term cost efficiency. 4. Why are dual kitchens becoming a standard in luxury home design? Dual kitchens allow the primary kitchen to serve as a clean, stylish gathering area for family and guests, while a fully equipped secondary prep kitchen handles heavy cooking and event catering behind closed doors. 5. How important is smart home technology in high-end real estate? Smart home technology is essential, but implementation matters. Today's luxury buyers prefer intuitive, centralized automation systems that quietly manage lighting, security, climate, and energy efficiency without requiring complex manual inputs.
